sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant further submits that in M.A. No. 5428/2019, contributory negligence has been wrongly fastened on the appellant/injured which needs removal.
On these aforesaid submissions, learned counsel prays for allowing the appeals by enhancing the award amount.
05. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / Insurance Company has opposed the prayer on the ground that evidence led before the learned Claims Tribunal has been rightly appreciated.
The amount awarded by the learned Claims Tribunal is just and proper and no enhancement is required.
All the factors have been considered by the learned Claims Tribunal while awarding the compensation amount and no fault can be found with in the impugned award.

Learned counsel for the respondent further NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:9064 3 MA-5427-2019 submits that in M.A. No. 5428/2019, contributory negligence has been rightly fastened by the learned Claims Tribunal which requires no interference.
Hence, prays for dismissal of the appeals being devoid of any substance.

06. Heard and considered the rival submissions raised at bar by learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
0 7 .

The income of the appellants/injured has been assessed by the Claims Tribunal as Rs.4,500/-
per month, whereas as per the circular issued under the Minimum Wages Act, the income of the injured on the date of accident i.e. 15.01.2016 comes to Rs.6575/- per month considering them 'Unskilled Labour', therefore, income of the injured is considered as Rs.6575/- per month.

Looking to the age of the injured Foramsingh 29 years and injured Narendra Singh 23 years at the time of accident, 40% future prospects is added in the amount of compensation as per para 59.4 of the judgment in the case of Pranay Sethi (Supra) .
08.

Accordingly, the just and proper compensation amount for appellant Forumsingh in M.A. No.
5427/2019 comes as under:

 Transportation: Rs.5000/-
For attendance: Rs.14,100/-

For special diet: Rs.14,100/-
 Total: Rs.3,06,072/-
 MACT Awarded: Rs.1,86,894/-
 Enhanced Amount: Rs.1,19,178/-
